messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: rollout v2-routing change for service 'router-api'. Proposed traffic split: 95% -> v1, 5% -> v2 (optimize-routing). Change window: immediate but requires 2 approvals for >1% traffic in prod. config:
```deploy --service router-api --variant optimize-routing --traffic 5% --region us-east-1```
Please review guards & telemetry dashboards. @maria @logan
maria: quick question — what's the kill-switch? if latency regresses, do we auto-rollback or shift traffic to fallback? we should also add a rate limit exemption for health-checks.
logan: we have the rollback hook enabled but it's conservative (20s tail latency + error rate >1%). worried about flapping if we auto rollback on short spikes. can we set a holdout window of 5m before rollback? :thinking_face:
tia: Suggest configuring a canary guard: min_samples=200 requests, observation_window=3m, metric_set=[p50,p95,error_rate]. If p95 increases by >30% AND error_rate >0.8% then fallback to v1. Also enable prefix KV cache bypass toggle for the variant.
sam: Ops note: dedicated capacity in us-east has thin headroom during the change window (12:00-14:00 UTC). If we exceed capacity, the router will redirect to regional fallback. We should set the traffic ramp: 1% -> 5% after 15m, not direct 5%.
oliver: Devex: UX in console should show a live 'experiment' panel with traffic chart and quick rollback button. I'll add a short PR for that; until then, add a manual rollback runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-router-api
maria: approving but want the holdout window and ramp change. Approving with comment: 'holdout=5m, ramp=1%->5% over 15m'.
logan: approve — will watch metrics and trigger manual rollback if needed. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Approval count: 2/2. Change window check passed (no infra outages). Scheduling rollout: start in 5m, ramp steps: 1% at t+5m, 5% at t+20m. Notifying on #incidents if thresholds tripped. ID: RB-20260318-004
tia: Adding telemetry watch: dashboard 'router-api/rollouts/RB-20260318-004' created, alert rules copied from template 'rollout-canary-v1'. Sam, please confirm quota exemptions for health checks.
sam: confirmed. Exemption rule applied for /health and /metrics from throttling.
oliver: also adding a note in the PR for console: 'show experiment id and linked runbook' 
maria: thanks — will be on-call during the window. Good to go.
